part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `contentNodeShifter.Insert` (hugolib/content_map_page.go:460): when a page was replaced in the page tree during a partial rebuild, the old (replaced) page node was not always marked stale — in particular the single-`*pageState` case returned the new node without marking the old one. Since stale-marking is what triggers cache invalidation and re-render of dependent page outputs, editing one page after another left the previously rendered page output untouched (no reload in `hugo server`).

The fix marks the replaced node as stale in all three cases of `Insert` (`*pageState`, `contentNodeIs`, `resourceSources`), guarding against marking a node that is identical to the new one.

Validation:
- `TestRebuildHomeThenPageIssue12436` (the FAIL_TO_PASS test already in the tree) now passes.
- `TestBenchmarkSiteDeepContentEdit` (expects `contentRenderCounter == 33`) passes.
- All `TestRebuild*` tests pass; the only failing tests in `./hugolib` (`TestBundleResourcesWhenLanguageVariantIsDraft`, `TestDraftNonDefaultContentLanguage`) also fail on the untouched baseline, so they're unrelated.
